|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Blaster Rack (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-blasterrack022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Blaster Rack”. Text: “Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, may deploy a matching weapon on that character from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blaster Rack (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-blasterracka5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “on table. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, may deploy” → “on table. Once per turn, may deploy”; “weapon on that character from” → “weapon on your unique (•) character present”; “that character from Reserve” → “(•) character present at a site from Reserve”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Blaster Rack”. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy a matching weapon on your unique (•) character present at a site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Blaster Rack (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-blasterrackab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
